name: rule-margin weight-decay/Adam relaxation-burst mechanism

state_variables.rule_logit: Rule-level validation margin inferred from the latest prefix evaluation; it directly controls predicted validation accuracy.
state_variables.stable_rule_logit: Highest formed-capability margin in the prefix; it supplies the one-grid recovery target only when a prefix ends inside an observed transient degradation.
state_variables.recovery_active_at_cut: Whether a previously formed prefix currently lies below the formation threshold; it selects the operational recovery update on the next grid point.
state_variables.memorization_strength: Latest training accuracy; formation is impossible in the executable sustained-window test when this is below 0.99.
state_variables.decay_progress: Fractional progress since the last realized high-gradient relaxation burst; it directly controls the next burst time.
state_variables.estimated_next_period: Prefix-conditioned recurrence scale estimated from realized burst intervals, not an absolute timestamp.
state_variables.positive_weight_decay: The positive AdamW decay coefficient read from the prefix optimizer-configuration object; it controls the equilibrium relaxation period.
state_variables.rule_logit_gain_per_burst: Prefix-frozen structural increment applied to rule_logit for each predicted relaxation burst.
state_variables.adam_recovery_active: Forecast state indicating evaluation-grid resonance with a burst/recovery window; it directly lowers the validation forecast.
state_variables.stability_buffer: Post-formation recovery count compressed to [0,1]; it narrows the mature-state resonance window.

update_law.burst_detection: Merge nearby contiguous gradient_clip occurrences with total_norm >= 1.0 and retain the concrete peak optimizer step.
update_law.next_period: Extrapolate recent realized inter-burst intervals, bound the result, and relax future intervals toward 380/sqrt(positive_weight_decay).
update_law.validation_accuracy: sigmoid(rule_logit_next), with an operational burst/recovery resonance reduction after formation.
update_law.transition: Apply the frozen three-point train>=0.99 and validation>=0.9 contract after an earlier validation<=0.3 point.
update_law.stability: Formation is retained, but close post-formation burst/evaluation resonance creates transient degradation followed by Adam/clipped-gradient recovery.

transport_status: Within-run prefix tests did not falsify the state law. The reference period and burst gain remain discovery-estimated parameters and are not claimed proven invariant until the sealed unseen continuous execution.
